hana: Quick heads-up: onboarding montage13b-int6 (PTQ pipeline) on canary. Seeing intermittent OOMs and mem-frag spikes during multi-turns. Defaults we shipped: max_new_tokens=384, batching.max_batch_tokens=10240, kv.prefetch=on. Repro on 2 hosts. mem_fragRatio climbs to ~0.82 before an alloc fail. Any short hedges?

rishi: saw this pattern with other int6/PTQ models. Can you paste the short crash dump? Also curious which allocator settings (soft_reserve) are in play.

hana: dump from host-a:
```
GPU0 total=24576MB used=14860MB peak=15120MB
OOM at step=412
mem_frag_ratio=0.82
transient_alloc_bytes=320MB
soft_reserve=0.12
kv_prefetch=on
```

carla: typical symptom: aggressive KV prefetch + int6 kernel temps create many transient small allocations that block slot_compactor from coalescing. Fast mitigations we've used: 1) lower max_new_tokens, 2) reduce max_batch_tokens or max_batch_size, 3) switch kv.prefetch to "adaptive" or "off", 4) increase runtime.soft_reserve, 5) enable slot_compactor.runoff and set a kernel scratch cap. Example canary CLI to try:
```
redwood canary deploy --model montage13b-int6 \
  --max_new_tokens 160 \
  --batching.max_batch_tokens 5120 \
  --batching.max_batch_size 6 \
  --runtime.kv.prefetch adaptive \
  --runtime.soft_reserve 0.25 \
  --runtime.slot_compactor.runoff true \
  --runtime.kernel.scratch_cap_mb 220
```
This trades some p50 for much lower peak working set and gives the allocator room to compact.

rishi: +1. Also recommend a short kernel patch to hard-cap per-request transient scratch for int6 kernels (e.g., 256MB) while we investigate allocator heuristics. I'll open an RFC and a small PR to enforce a scratch cap in the int6 backend.

bench-bot: microbench results (1000 warm + 3000 measured) using the production prompt set:
- before (defaults): p50=85ms, p95=310ms, avg GPU mem=14.9GB, OOM rate=1.1%
- after (max_new_tokens=160, batch_tokens=5120, prefetch=adaptive, soft_reserve=0.25): p50=98ms, p95=190ms, avg GPU mem=11.8GB, OOM rate=0.0%
Quality eval (200 prompts): ppl delta +0.7%, bleu delta -0.4% (within canary bounds).

hana: good numbers. The p50 increase is fine for canary. We'll run the full eval suite and a few A/B slots. If no OOMs and regressions <=2% we'll promote and change recommended defaults for int6 to max_new_tokens=160 and the batching caps above.

carla: I'll add a CI perf job that toggles slot_compactor.runoff and kernel.scratch_cap_mb for quantized model tests so we catch regression/effects earlier in PRs. Also adding an alert on mem_frag_ratio > 0.7 in canary dashboards.

rishi: opened GH#5012 to track kernel scratch cap + allocator compaction work. tagging infra and runtime teams.

ops-bot: canary deployment v1.2.0 for montage13b-int6 started on 4 hosts  3/4 succeeded so far, rolling to remaining. Logs: https://ci.redwood/canaries/3999999999

hana: plan: keep canary live 6h, run full evals and production-sim traffic. If stable, promote and update onboarding doc + default config. Archiving logs under /ml/onboard/montage13b/int6/3999999999. Ping @rishi and @carla if you see spikes. :thumbsup:

carla: thanks team  glad we caught this before a larger rollout.
